images.title: Four shapes and one statement
images.purpose: Show the four shapes of the concept's example side by side with their side lengths and right angle marks, so that the sides and the angles that tell the shapes apart can be counted, and show that opposite sides are equal in all four.
images.composition: A 2 by 2 arrangement: the square and the rectangle on top, the rhombus and the parallelogram below, each with its letter, its name and the length of every side, and one line of text across the bottom.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816, four shapes in a 2 by 2 arrangement and one line of text across the bottom. Scale: 28 px for each 1 cm. Every shape has a thin dark #2B2B2B outline (3 px) and a flat fill. All side labels are 28 px, dark #1F2937. SHAPE X (top left): a square with side 168 px, corners (330, 100), (498, 100), (498, 268), (330, 268), filled teal #0072B2, with a small white square mark (20 px, thin dark outline) inside each of its 4 corners to show a right angle. Its 4 side labels, all 6 cm: above the top side at (414, 78), below the bottom side at (414, 302), left of the left side at (284, 184), right of the right side at (544, 184). Beside it, on the left: the letter X (bold, 64 px) at (110, 175) and the word square (36 px) at (110, 230). SHAPE Y (top right): a rectangle 252 px wide and 112 px high, corners (1010, 128), (1262, 128), (1262, 240), (1010, 240), filled amber #E69F00, with a white right angle mark (20 px) inside each of its 4 corners. Its 4 side labels: 9 cm above the top side at (1136, 106), 9 cm below the bottom side at (1136, 274), 4 cm left of the left side at (965, 184), 4 cm right of the right side at (1307, 184). Beside it, on the left: the letter Y (bold, 64 px) at (830, 175) and the word rectangle (36 px) at (830, 230). SHAPE Z (bottom left): a rhombus with 4 equal sides of 196 px, corners (320, 650), (516, 650), (614, 480), (418, 480), filled reddish purple #CC79A7, with no right angle marks. Its 4 side labels, all 7 cm: above the top side at (516, 458), below the bottom side at (418, 686), beside the left side at (331, 543), beside the right side at (603, 587). Beside it, on the left: the letter Z (bold, 64 px) at (110, 560) and the word rhombus (36 px) at (110, 615). SHAPE W (bottom right): a parallelogram with a bottom side and a top side of 224 px and two slanted sides of 140 px, corners (1010, 650), (1234, 650), (1318, 538), (1094, 538), filled green #009E73, with no right angle marks. Its 4 side labels: 8 cm above the top side at (1206, 516), 8 cm below the bottom side at (1122, 686), 5 cm beside the left side at (1017, 568), 5 cm beside the right side at (1311, 620). Beside it, on the left: the letter W (bold, 64 px) at (830, 560) and the word parallelogram (36 px) at (830, 615). Across the bottom, centred at (728, 765): one line of bold dark text, Opposite sides are equal in all four shapes (44 px). In all, 16 side labels (6 cm 4 times, 7 cm 4 times, 9 cm 2 times, 4 cm 2 times, 8 cm 2 times, 5 cm 2 times), 8 right angle marks and 4 letters. Nothing else in the frame.
labels: Opposite sides are equal in all four shapes
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any count of shapes, side labels or right angle marks that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
right angle marks on the rhombus or the parallelogram
a side label that differs from the stated length of its side
images.takeaway: Square, rectangle, rhombus and parallelogram all have opposite sides equal, so one statement about opposite sides fits all four shapes.
images.description: Four labelled shapes, X a square, Y a rectangle, Z a rhombus and W a parallelogram, with every side length written beside it and right angle marks on X and Y.
images.context: Concept image for Square, Rectangle, Rhombus and Parallelogram. It shows the concept's own four shapes (sides 6, 9 and 4, 7, 8 and 5) and not a figure from your maths book.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the child first for the sides, then for the angles. The slip to watch is thinking that a rectangle is not a parallelogram: its opposite sides are equal, so it is one.

image_decisions.why: The four shapes with every side length and the right angle marks drawn are the mathematics: the child counts equal sides and right angles from the picture.
